item.envelope_automate.seal_stamp.finger: Sneak + Use to record your fingerprint
gui.envelope_automate.mail_packager.inpu: Items piped in wait here. A redstone pulse packs up to one package worth of them. While powered, it also packs automatically as soon as the buffer fills a whole box (all 6 slots full) or once nothing has been added or removed for 1.5 seconds.
gui.envelope_automate.mail_packager.outp: Contents of packages received by the attached mailbox. Pipes can extract from here.
gui.envelope_automate.mail_packager.addr: Packages are addressed to this tag's address. The tag is not consumed.
gui.envelope_automate.mail_packager.seal: Packages are sealed with this stamp, signed as the stamp's fingerprint (or the packager's owner if it has none). The stamp is not consumed.
gui.envelope_automate.mail_packager.outg: Waits here until the attached mailbox's outgoing slot is free. No new package is packed while one is waiting.
gui.envelope_automate.mail_packager.mode: Packages are picked up by a courier and travel through the sorting facility. They reach any address.
A pigeon flies each package straight to the recipient's mailbox, skipping the sorting facility. No courier food is needed, but the mailbox must be loaded and within 8 chunks.
gui.envelope_automate.depository_termina: Use a seal stamp on the terminal to insert it. With a fingerprint, the terminal shows and orders from that player's account. Orders are sealed with the stamp.
Cloud Depository is disabled on this server
Click: +1  Shift: +stack  Ctrl: all  Right-click: remove
